goal: Add a DELETE /todos/:id endpoint that removes a todo item and returns 204, or 404 for unknown ids.
scope_summary: Add a delete method to the store class that removes an item by id and returns a boolean. Add a router.delete handler that calls store.delete, returning 204 on success or 404 with JSON error. Add two test cases in the existing describe/test structure.
planned_changes: Add delete(id) method to the store class in src/store.ts returning boolean
Add router.delete handler in src/routes/todos.ts following existing 404 pattern
Add test that creates an item, deletes it, asserts 204, then confirms GET /todos no longer includes it
Add test that sends DELETE to /todos/999 and asserts 404 with JSON error
acceptance_checks: DELETE /todos/:id returns 404 with JSON error for unknown id
Deleted item no longer appears in GET /todos or GET /todos/:id
Unit test: todos.test.ts > DELETE /todos/:id removes the item verifies deletion
Unit test: todos.test.ts > DELETE /todos/:id returns 404 for unknown id verifies not-found
commit_message: feat(F007): add DELETE /todos/:id endpoint with tests
risks: Store delete must use Map.delete and return the boolean result so the router can distinguish found vs not-found
Test names must match acceptance criteria exactly for automated verification
